title: Paul and Linda McCartney watch David Bowie perform in Nashville | 1974
content:
Paul and Linda McCartney watched David Bowie perform at Nashville’s Municipal Auditorium on 29 June 1974.

It was the 13th date of the Diamond Dogs Tour, which had kicked off in Montreal on 14 June. The tour returned to Nashville on 30 November.

The McCartneys were staying in Nashville in the summer of 1974, and Linda photographed Bowie backstage. Afterwards they attended the show’s after-party at Bowie’s hotel.

The ambitious show, which saw Bowie moving into soul music with a large ensemble of musicians, partly inspired Paul to expand Wings’ line-up to include a brass section.
